purpose: Offline regression policy illustration only; thresholds are synthetic test values, not shipping requirements or validated clinical/device health.
rules: Separate link, service, subscriptions, recovery marker and observed progress.
Connected or audio_recovered with absent/null counters never implies healthy audio.
Only a positive same-session counter delta is progress evidence; reset/unknown counters cannot fabricate it.
A progress timeout means policy concern between sampled snapshots; never proof of continuous outage or root cause.
Keep recorded disconnect reason, RSSI age and lost_audio_seconds without packet arithmetic substitution.
Coalesce retry scheduling, bound backoff/attempts under injected virtual time; emit proposals, perform no reconnects.
No RSSI threshold or Android timeout rule is inferred from the three weak samples.
